blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Autoregressive video diffusion models have emerged as a foundation for long-horizon world rollout. However, when extended far beyond their training windows, these models suffer from progressive drift: visual quality deteriorates, motion becomes inconsistent, and object identity gradually collapses as generated frames are recursively reused as context. We study a supervision-horizon gap: short-horizon distillation leaves later rollout states without direct supervision. We show that matching short-window marginals need not determine long-horizon behavior, while longer on-policy trajectories expose delayed failures to training. This motivates temporal manifold matching at scale for long-horizon world models. Building on this insight, we introduce LongForcing, a distillation approach that scales teacher supervision to long student self-rollouts. LongForcing preserves the short-horizon teacher-forcing and causal ODE-distillation stages, while replacing the realscore teacher in the final distribution-matching stage with an extended-horizon bidirectional teacher. The long-horizon teacher supervises extended student self-rollouts using the standard distribution-matching formulation, without modifying the student architecture or increasing inference cost. We evaluate LongForcing on text-to-video generation and interactive action-conditioned world models, achieving a VBench Quality score of 85.52 and improving WorldRoamBench 60s action score by 23.9 points in first-person ablations. Qualitative stress tests further sample interactive rollouts up to 24 hours, far beyond the training horizon. These results suggest that scaling supervision along the temporal axis is a practical step toward long-horizon world models. The project website and code are at https://github.com/Fantasy-AMAP/LongForcing.

blocks.en: 1  Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: “We can only see a short distance ahead, but we can see plenty there that needs to be done.” — Alan Turing
blocks.zh: “我们只能看到前面很短的路程,但我们可以看到需要做的很多事情。”

blocks.en:
Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models are becoming a foundational paradigm for long-horizon world rollout.
An AR model generates video chunk by chunk, with each new chunk conditioned on previously generated frames.
Repeating this process enables rollouts far longer than individual training clips.
This capability is essential for both interactive world models [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 ] , where a world must remain coherent and responsive as the user acts, and long-form text-to-video systems [ 7 , 8 ] , where visual quality, motion, and identity must persist far beyond the initial clip.
However, the same recursive mechanism that enables long rollouts also makes AR models vulnerable to rollout drift .
Because every generated chunk becomes context for the next, small errors compound, the conditioning distribution moves away from the data seen during training, and the model gradually loses visual fidelity.
blocks.zh:
自动(AR)视频传播模型正成为长视界世界推出的基础范式.
AR模型逐块生成视频块,每个新块以先前生成的帧为条件.
重复这一程序使得推广的时间远远长于个别培训剪辑。
这一能力对于互动的世界模式[1、2、3、4、5、6]和长式文本到视频系统[7、8]都至关重要,在这两个模式中,视觉质量、运动和身份必须远远超过最初的剪辑。
然而,同样能够长期推出的递归机制也使得AR模型容易被推出漂移。
因为每个生成的块都会成为下一个小错误复合物的上下文,所以调制分布会远离训练时看到的数据,模型逐渐失去视觉的忠诚.

blocks.en:
Modern real-time AR video generators are often obtained through a three-stage distillation pipeline.
Teacher forcing first adapts a bidirectional video model to causal conditioning, ODE distillation compresses its denoising trajectory into a few-step generator, and distribution matching distillation (DMD) aligns the student’s self-generated distribution with a teacher [ 9 , 8 , 10 ] .
This recipe is highly effective within the few-second horizon on which it is trained, but deployment requires closed-loop generation over minutes.
Teacher forcing learns from short clean histories, causal ODE distillation uses short teacher-generated trajectories, and short-horizon DMD evaluates only short student rollouts; later rollout states receive no direct supervision from this objective.
blocks.zh:
现代实时AR视频发电机经常通过三级蒸馏管道获得.
教师强制首先将双向视频模型适应因果条件,ODE蒸馏压缩其去诺的轨迹成为几步生成器,发行匹配蒸馏(DMD)则将学生自行生成的发行与教师对齐[9,8,10].
这种配方在它接受训练的几秒钟内非常有效,但部署需要几分钟的闭路发电。
教师强迫学习短清历史,因果ODE蒸馏使用短清教师生成的轨迹,短平面DMD只评价短清学生推出;后来推出的州没有直接接受这一目标的监督.

blocks.en:
Recent approaches mitigate long-horizon drift through sparse local matching [ 11 ] , inference-time memory and positional modifications [ 12 , 13 , 14 ] , or context perturbation [ 15 ] .
Local matching can supervise late rollout states, but its jointly scored windows remain short; inference-time modifications instead stabilize the conditioning context.
Neither mechanism by itself matches the longer joint path, leaving cross-window dependencies that can affect visual fidelity, identity, dynamics, and action consistency.
blocks.zh:
最近的办法通过稀少的局部匹配[11]、推断时间记忆和位置改变[12、13、14]或上下文扰动[15],减轻了长距离漂移。
本地匹配可以监督后期推出状态,但其联合得分的窗口仍然很短;推论时间修改而不是稳定条件上下文.
这两种机制本身都不符合较长的联合路径,留下了可以影响视觉忠诚、身份、动态和行动一致性的跨窗口依赖性。

blocks.en:
These failures reveal a supervision-horizon gap between short-window training and long-horizon deployment.
Our principle is that temporal manifold matching should scale with the trajectories visited on policy , where temporal manifold informally describes high-probability regions of the teacher’s path distribution.
Section 4 formalizes this view using path distributions, KL divergence, and total variation.
Matching short windows does not determine the distribution of a long rollout, whereas matching clean trajectories controls drift within the supervised horizon.
Beyond this horizon, stability also depends on teacher leakage, student–teacher mismatch along visited states, and recovery from drifted states.
This motivates extending distribution matching over longer student rollouts while keeping teacher forcing and ODE distillation short.
blocks.zh:
这些失败暴露了短窗培训和长视距部署之间的监督范围差距。
我们的原则是,时间的多重匹配应该与政策上的轨迹相适应,因为时间的多重非正式地描述了教师路径分布的高概率地区。
第4节使用路径分布、KL差异和总差异来正式确定这一观点。
匹配短窗口并不决定长展的分布,而匹配干净的轨迹控制在被监管的视野内漂移.
在这个地平线之外,稳定还取决于教师渗漏、受访各州学生和教师不匹配以及漂移各州的复苏。
这促使扩大分发范围,使学生更长时间地推广,同时缩短教师的强迫和ODE蒸馏时间。

blocks.en:
Guided by this principle, we introduce LongForcing , which replaces Causal Forcing’s DMD real-score teacher with an extended-horizon teacher for longer self-generated trajectories.
The student rolls out on policy, while an extended-horizon teacher supplies distribution-level supervision across a long, contiguous portion of each self-generated training trajectory, requiring no architectural changes.
Empirically, LongForcing improves text-to-video VBench Quality by 0.93 points over Causal Forcing and raises WorldRoamBench 60s action score by 23.9 points (37% relative) in first-person ablations. Qualitative stress tests sample interactive rollouts up to 24 hours .
These results position temporal manifold matching at scale as a practical step toward long-horizon world models.
blocks.zh:
在这一原则的指导下,我们引入了LongForcing,它取代了Causal Forcing的DMD真分数教师,代之以扩展视距教师,进行更长的自创轨迹.
学生们推行政策,而远距离教师则提供分布式监督,覆盖每个自我创造的训练轨迹中长期、毗连的部分,不需要改变建筑结构。
经验性地说,LongForcing在Causal Forcing上将文本对视频V Bench质量提升0.93分,并在第一人称擦伤中将WorldRoam Bench 60s动作分提高23.9分(相对37%). 质量压力测试样本 互动推出24小时。
这些结果将时间多重规模的匹配定位为迈向远视世界模式的实际步骤。

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold: • We formalize the supervision-horizon gap : longer student rollouts expose delayed failures, and joint path matching constrains dependencies left undetermined by local-window marginals. • We introduce LongForcing , which extends the teacher’s supervision horizon in distribution-matching distillation to guide longer student-generated trajectories. • We evaluate LongForcing across interactive world models and text-to-video generation, measuring improvements in action following and video quality alongside their dependence on supervision length.

blocks.en: 2  Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1  Autoregressive Long-Video Generation
blocks.zh: 2.1 自动反向长视频生成

blocks.en:
Autoregressive video generation has evolved from discrete-token transformers [ 16 , 17 , 18 , 19 ] to diffusion and flow models that stream through temporally varying noise levels, causal attention, or sliding-window denoising [ 20 , 21 , 22 , 23 , 24 ] .
Few-step variants further use video DMD, student-generated contexts, progressive-window denoising, corrected causal ODE initialization, or diagonal distillation [ 9 , 8 , 25 , 10 , 26 ] .
To extend generation beyond the training horizon, training-free methods modify noise schedules, denoising windows, attention, positional encodings, or temporal memory [ 27 , 7 , 13 , 14 , 28 , 29 ] , whereas training-based approaches use self-generated segments, long-context tuning, hierarchical denoising, and drift simulation [ 11 , 30 , 31 , 32 , 33 ] .
Context Forcing [ 31 ] also uses a long-context teacher, combining continuation-conditioned DMD with Slow-Fast Memory. LongForcing retains Causal Forcing’s student architecture and inference procedure, replacing its DMD teacher to score a longer contiguous, jointly noised student path.
blocks.zh:
自动回转式视频生成已从离散式变压器[16,17,18,19]演变为流经时空变化的噪声水平,因果注意,或滑动窗去诺[20,21,22,23,24]的传播和流动模型.
少步变体进一步使用视频DMD,学生生成的语境,渐进窗去诺化,修正因果ODE初始化,或对角蒸馏[9,8,25,10,26].
将生成扩展至训练视野以外,无训练方法修改噪音表,调试窗口,注意,位置编码,或时间记忆[27,7,13,14,28,29],而基于训练方法则使用自产生段,长调,分级调试,以及漂移模拟[11,30,31,32,33].
背景强制 [31] 也使用长写老师,将续订条件的DMD与慢速记忆结合. LongForcing保留了Causal Forcing的学生建筑和推论程序,取代了DMD的老师,以获得一个更连续,联合点名的学生路径.

blocks.en: 2.2  Interactive World Models
blocks.zh: 2.2 互动世界模式

blocks.en:
Interactive world models use video generation as a controllable simulator for prediction, exploration, and closed-loop interaction.
Recent systems demonstrate playable game simulation [ 3 , 4 , 34 ] , camera and action-controlled world exploration [ 5 , 35 , 6 ] , and real-time interactive generation [ 2 , 36 , 37 ] .
Unlike prompt-driven video generation, interactive rollout must preserve both world state and the consequences of continuously changing user actions.
Over extended sessions, accumulated errors can therefore degrade not only visual fidelity and identity, but also action responsiveness and physical consistency.
WorldRoamBench [ 38 ] explicitly evaluates these long-horizon properties across diverse interactive environments.
LongForcing scales teacher supervision of on-policy rollouts along the temporal axis in both interactive and text-conditioned generation.
Qualitative stress tests sample interactive rollouts up to 24 hours , complementing the benchmark evaluation.
blocks.zh:
互动世界模型使用视频生成作为可控模拟器,用于预测,探索,以及闭路交互.
最近的系统展示了可玩游戏模拟[3,4,34],相机和动作控制的世界探索[5,35,6],以及实时交互生成[2,36,37].
与即时驱动的视频生成不同,互动推出必须既保护世界状态,也保护用户行为持续变化的后果.
因此,在扩展的会话中,累积的错误不仅会降低视觉的忠诚度和身份,而且会降低动作的响应性和物理一致性。
WorldRoam Bench [38] 明确评价这些跨越不同互动环境的长视野特性.
在交互式和文本条件下的生成中,按时间轴对政策推出进行教师监督。
定性压力测试抽样互动推广,最长可达24小时,补充基准评价。

blocks.en: 3  Drift in Autoregressive Video Rollouts
blocks.zh: 3 自动递录视频的漂移

blocks.en: 3.2  Why Autoregressive Rollouts Drift
blocks.zh: 3.2 为何自动推出

blocks.en: Long-video drift can appear as position or color shift, amplified blur and noise, and action inconsistency [ 33 ] . These mechanisms share a temporal structure: generated chunks recursively change the conditioning distribution. The relevant train–test mismatch is therefore between the short prefixes evaluated during training and the evolving on-policy path traversed during long deployment.

blocks.en: 7  Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
We identify a supervision-horizon gap in autoregressive video generation: short-horizon supervision leaves later rollout behavior underdetermined, while longer on-policy trajectories expose delayed failures to teacher guidance.
LongForcing addresses this gap by replacing Causal Forcing’s DMD real-score teacher with an extended-horizon teacher that supervises longer student self-rollouts, while retaining its short teacher-forcing and causal ODE-distillation stages.
Across text-to-video generation and interactive world models, this improves VBench Quality by 0.93 points and first-person action score by 23.9 points over the respective baselines, without changing the architecture or increasing inference cost.
Horizon ablations and time-resolved evaluations show reduced rollout drift, complemented by qualitative interactive stress tests sampled up to 24 hours.
These findings position temporal supervision as a scaling dimension for video world models.
Integrating coherent visual rollouts with persistent memory and hierarchical planning offers a path toward persistent interactive worlds, goal-directed behavior, and long-term reasoning.

LongForcing通过将Causal Forcing的DMD真分数教师替换为监督学生自学时间较长的扩展视距教师来解决这一差距,同时保留其简短的教师强制和因果ODE-dispiration阶段.

blocks.en:
LongForcing retains the teacher-forcing and causal ODE-distillation stages of Causal Forcing and replaces the real-score teacher in its final DMD stage with an extended-horizon bidirectional teacher.
Teacher forcing uses short clean histories and causal ODE distillation uses short trajectories from the causal teacher; the resulting student generates a contiguous H H -chunk closed-loop path, scored jointly by the replacement teacher and the online fake-score network.
The student architecture, sampler, and inference procedure remain unchanged.
Under the causal VAE mapping, 81, 161, 241, and 321 decoded RGB frames correspond to 21, 41, 61, and 81 temporal latent positions, respectively; these positions are rounded and grouped into autoregressive chunks of three latent frames.

We train the interactive teachers for 20,000 steps with a learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} and a global batch size of 256 video clips.
We use action-annotated video sequences, with the action sequence aligned to the video over the teacher’s temporal window.
The teacher retains bidirectional temporal attention so that it can evaluate the complete student-generated path with its corresponding actions.
The data collection and annotation pipeline is described in ABot-World [ 49 ] ; the long teacher provides the frozen real-score network for our 321-frame DMD stage.

blocks.en:
We initialize the bidirectional teacher from the pretrained Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B checkpoint [ 43 ] and fine-tune it on UltraVideo-Long [ 50 ] for three epochs, with each training example visited once per epoch.
Videos are sampled at 16 FPS and processed at 832 × 480 832\times 480 resolution, using 321-frame clips for the long teacher.
The horizon study uses separate teacher checkpoints for the 81-, 161-, 241-, and 321-frame DMD configurations, pairing each rollout length with its corresponding teacher.
The pretrained Wan VAE and UMT5 text encoder remain frozen; video latents and text embeddings are cached before optimization.
We optimize a supervised flow-matching loss on the noisy video latents, sampling a diffusion timestep and Gaussian noise anew for each example and applying the scheduler’s timestep-dependent loss weight.
Adaptation uses rank-64 LoRA with scaling parameter α = 64 \alpha=64 in the DiT attention projections ( q,k,v,o ) and feed-forward projections ( ffn.0,ffn.2 ); the underlying pretrained weights remain frozen.
AdamW uses a base learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , weight decay 0.01 0.01 , and its default momentum parameters ( 0.9 , 0.999 ) (0.9,0.999) .
The implementation uses BF16 model parameters, evaluates the mean-squared-error loss in FP32, enables gradient checkpointing, and processes one clip per GPU without gradient accumulation, giving a global batch size of 32 clips.
After adaptation, the resulting teacher is frozen during DMD; only the causal generator and the online fake-score network are updated in that stage.

blocks.en: Appendix E Discussion
blocks.zh: 附录E 讨论情况

blocks.en: Horizon scaling targets failures first reached beyond the shorter training window. Extending the on-policy rollout makes these later prefixes available to the teacher, while the horizon ablations quantify the resulting empirical changes in generation quality. The benefit depends on both supervision coverage and the quality of the teacher signal on those prefixes.
blocks.zh: 地平线缩放目标首先在较短的培训窗口之外达到失败。 扩大政策推广使得这些后期的前缀可供教师使用,而视野的扩展则量化了由此产生的发电质量的经验变化。 津贴取决于监督覆盖范围和这些前缀上的教师信号的质量。

blocks.en: The additional computation occurs during training: the student generates longer paths and both score networks process longer sequences. At fixed spatial resolution, dense bidirectional attention has quadratic attention-score computation in temporal length; practical memory and runtime depend on the attention and gradient implementations. For a fixed inference configuration and output length, the student uses the same architecture and sampling operations as the short-horizon baseline.

blocks.en: The finite-horizon results quantify teacher-relative path agreement, while the blockwise extension additionally assumes controlled leakage, mismatch, and recovery on the student’s start distribution. The long-run extension states its uniform dynamical assumptions separately. These conditions concern the specified model, domain, and action protocol. Visual quality, motion, and action following are evaluated separately, complementing the drift analysis.
blocks.zh: 有限范围的结果量化了师生关系路径协议,而阻断扩展则在学生的初始分配上额外假定了有控制的渗漏、不匹配和复苏。 长期延期分别说明其统一的动态假设. 这些条件涉及指定的模式、域和行动协议。 对视觉质量、运动和随后的行动分别进行评估,以补充漂移分析。

blocks.en:
A useful supervision horizon depends on when task-relevant dependencies and failure modes become observable, rather than on a universal duration.
For scene roaming, delayed effects may involve revisiting a location or maintaining an object after a long absence; for goal-directed interaction, an action’s consequence may appear much later.
Our horizon sweep measures the benefit of extending supervision within the tested range; determining a sufficient horizon for a new task calls for evaluating those dependencies over the intended deployment duration.
A promising direction is to allocate longer training rollouts when delayed errors remain frequent, and to compare this adaptive allocation with fixed horizons under matched compute budgets.
Teacher quality and persistent memory offer complementary ways to make additional temporal coverage useful.
blocks.zh:
一个有用的监督范围取决于何时可以观察到与任务有关的依赖性和失败模式,而不是一个普遍的期限。
就场景漫游而言,延迟效应可能涉及在长期缺席后重新审视一个位置或保持一个物体;就目标导向的相互作用而言,一个行动的后果可能远较迟。
我们的视野可以衡量在试验范围内扩大监督的好处;确定一项新任务的充分前景需要对这些依赖性在预定部署期间进行评估。
一个有希望的方向是,在延迟错误仍然频繁发生时,分配较长的培训推广时间,并将这种适应性分配与相应的预算下的固定范围进行比较。
教师的素质和持续的记忆为增加时间覆盖面提供了补充方法。

blocks.en:
Maintaining a coherent visual trajectory and deciding which events should occur over a long story or task are complementary problems.
LongForcing strengthens the former by supervising longer self-generated paths; long-term planning additionally requires representing goals, organizing events, and retaining consequences across distant steps.
This suggests a hierarchical approach in which a planner maintains an abstract state and selects subgoals, persistent memory records relevant past events, and a video model renders the resulting interactions.
Long-horizon supervision could then assess whether the rendered trajectory respects those plans and remembered consequences.
Evaluating delayed action effects, goal completion, and narrative consistency alongside visual quality would help determine whether longer rollouts also support more coherent long-term behavior.
blocks.zh:
保持连贯的视觉轨迹,决定哪些事件应在长篇大论或任务中发生,是相辅相成的问题。
长期强制措施通过监督较长的自我创造道路来加强前者;长期规划还需要代表目标、组织活动以及保留遥远步骤的后果。
这表明一种分级的方法,即规划者保持抽象状态,并选择子目标,持续的内存记录相关的过去事件,以及视频模型使由此产生的互动产生.
然后,长视距监督可以评估所提供的轨迹是否尊重这些计划并铭记后果。
评估延迟的行动效果、目标完成和叙述一致性,以及视觉质量,将有助于确定较长的推出是否也支持更一致的长期行为。
